a.lede: Chatbots can skew election-related information and act as an intervening layer in a voter’s search, Yale researchers find.
a.title: Researchers asked people to use AI chatbots for election info – results were mixed

b.lede: From hallucinations to partisan bias, artificial intelligence chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful when it comes to Election Day.
b.title: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
